jobs.title: Supervising Physician for California
jobs.description: About Dreem Health , by Sunrise Dreem Health is America’s leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise’s technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We’re fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule. Your opportunity As an MD at Dreem Health, you're transforming how sleep care is delivered—bringing high-quality, evidence-based treatment to patients through a modern, fully remote platform. Our clinical model offers the best of both worlds: the flexibility to work from home with no commute or unnecessary admin burden, and the opportunity to make a real impact at scale. Unlike traditional sleep clinics—where providers are often tied to 36+ hours of patient visits and limited in scope—our clinicians focus on just 20 hours of patient care per week, with additional time dedicated to interpretation, collaboration, and contributing to the growth of our model. You’re not just a cog in the wheel—you’ll help shape the way sleep medicine is practiced nationally. We’re growing fast and on track to become the largest sleep provider in the U.S.. If you're passionate about clinical excellence, excited by innovation, and interested in mentoring the next generation of sleep clinicians, Dreem Health is the place to grow your career. What you bring M.D. with a preference of experience in family medicine, ENT, neurology, or anesthesiology Must be licensed in CA and at least one additional state Board Certified in Sleep Medicine 1+ years in sleep medicine or sleep fellowship completion Startup mindset: Scrappy, solutions-oriented, and hands-on, with strong clinical training and a “build, test, learn” approach—not bound by traditional care models. jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Drug Development & Clinical Strategy
jobs.description: Position Summary:  Quotient is seeking a highly analytical and scientifically curious Senior Analyst to support strategic decision-making across our growing drug development pipeline. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of analytics, market intelligence, commercial strategy and early drug development in a genetics-based biotech company.  The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and familiarity with scientific and clinical data with commercial curiosity, to turn networks of complex data into meaningful insights. In doing so, the successful candidate will help us better understand where high-value, tractable drug development opportunities exist across our internal pipeline of drug targets, and more broadly across a range of disease areas. Together with other members of the drug development team, this role will help focus which indications, patient segments, and development paths we should consider, and where data can help inform our investment and planning decisions. This role could be based in our UK or US office and will report to the Chief Development Officer. jobs.title: Consultant Psychiatrist PAYE
jobs.description: An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices. Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards. Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. In this Individual contributor People Business Partner role, you will translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth. You will partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up. jobs.title: Senior Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology , we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines. What you'll do You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation. Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny. Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality

jobs.title: Clinical Data Systems & Data Management
jobs.description: Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. As a Clinical Data Systems & Data Management Lead , you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, integrity, security, and accessibility of clinical trial data. You will act as the bridge between Clinical Operations, Data Management, IT, and Quality teams while supporting the deployment, administration, and evolution of clinical research systems. Key Responsibilities Provide methodological and technical support for the design and deployment of clinical data collection tools (eCRF). Administer clinical research systems, including eTMF, CTMS, GED/QMS, TRMS, and other business applications. Manage interfaces and APIs between key clinical systems to ensure seamless data flow. Oversee the storage, archiving, security, and integrity of clinical study databases. Contribute to the definition and deployment of the organization's Data Management strategy. Ensure compliance with GCP, GDPR Participate in SOP development, user training, and support activities. Drive digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives within clinical research operations. Requirements Education Master's degree in Data Science, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Management, Life Sciences, or a related field. Experience Significant experience in Clinical Data Management and/or administration of computerized clinical systems. Technical Skills Strong understanding of clinical trial data management processes and clinical research environments. Experience with clinical systems such as eTMF, CTMS, eCRF, GED/QMS, or related platforms. Knowledge of Ennov Clinical and/or REDCap is a plus. Familiarity with SAS, R, SPSS, or other statistical tools is advantageous. Understanding of GCP, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Languages Professional proficiency in English. Benefits Why

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
